resources.string: Choose a playlist and channel. Override only what is needed; other values inherit existing settings. Includes HLS-only exceptions.
Allow other formats for this channel
HLS-only keeps ExoPlayer by default. Selecting mpv explicitly keeps HLS without switching to direct TS.
Media reserve to absorb fluctuations. Initial pre-buffer can raise this minimum. This is not a memory limit.
Added to the reserve to set the read-ahead limit. Stream availability may limit the actual buffer.
Waits only before initial playback. Recovery still resumes as soon as playable media is available.
Target live offset for HLS/DASH in ExoPlayer. Has no effect on direct TS and does not guarantee the actual delay.
Adjusts synchronization with video; does not fix buffering. Overrides audio delay remembered in the player.
Save and reopen the channel. Changes do not interrupt current playback.
HLS: detect video frame boundaries — ExoPlayer
Only for H.264 in MPEG-TS segments without delimiters. Uses more processing. Leave disabled unless needed.
Only for H.264 in MPEG-TS segments without IDR frames. May cause temporary picture corruption on opening or seeking.
HLS: discover tracks from segments — ExoPlayer
For certain track discovery problems. Slower opening; does not generally fix buffering or incorrect CODECS declarations.
